verdict.rationale: Evidence shows tax calculation, registration monitoring, and transaction reports/exports (docs-11, docs-19) plus a TaxJar integration for US filing (docs-10), but nothing about a filing calendar, per-filing status tracker, remitted-amount summaries, or downloadable filing confirmations. Community comments (stripe-tax-comm-5) explicitly note that after using Stripe Tax you 'still have to do everything yourself - filing the papers and wiring money,' underscoring the absence of an in-product filing dashboard.
